extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to create a new Wikipedia article / new Wikipedia contributors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors who find that an intended Wikipedia page does not exist and want to create or recover that article (searching, account requirements, redirects, deletion checks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Seth Meyers WHCD" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for alternative titles or spellings and search existing content first to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can show whether the topic is mentioned elsewhere and help determine the correct title or whether a redirect is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case sensitive (except first character); consider redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and create redirects to the canonical title if appropriate to improve discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may be delayed from appearing
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to refresh the database/view.

rubrics_metrics.name: If the page was deleted, check the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the deletion log to find deletion reasons and guidance on how to address issues (notability, sourcing, policy violations) before reattempting creation.
